description: Dispatch an async read of Marketo's named account object description (GET /rest/v1/namedaccounts/describe.json). The finished job writes the field descriptors to output_tsv_path and returns id_field, dedupe_fields and searchable_fields, which are the valid filter_type values for get_named_accounts. Poll check_marketo_job_status.
embedding_description: Describe the Marketo named account (ABM target account) object: field names, data types, the marketoGUID id field, the name dedupe field and the searchable fields that get_named_accounts accepts as filter_type. Async job writes the field list to a workspace TSV. Distinct from get_named_accounts, which returns records.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo named accounts describe job dispatched
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id and status 'queued'. The completed job result is a TSV handle of the field descriptors (path, columns, row_count) plus object_name, id_field, dedupe_fields and searchable_fields.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the job was dispatched and give the job_id. Once completed, name the id_field and dedupe_fields and point at the TSV for the full field list; searchable_fields are the valid filter_type values.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read the Marketo named account object description from the configured instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: refused at dispatch before any vendor call (missing or malformed parameters, more than 300 entries, an action/dedupe_by/delete_by value Marketo does not define). On the finished job: marketo.permission_denied (vendor 603 or HTTP 403) means the API user's Role lacks the Access API permission; marketo.auth_failed (601/602 after one re-mint, or HTTP 401) means the credential was rejected; marketo.validation_failed and other vendor codes carry Marketo's own message.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.permission_denied: grant Read-Only Named Account (or Read-Write Named Account) under Admin > Users & Roles > Roles > the API role > Access API, then retry. Adobe documents some Lead Database object APIs as unavailable on subscriptions with a native CRM sync; that vendor error is reported as returned.
